figures.name: Buga

ability.name: World Creation
ability.description: Create any terrain card; the world itself reshapes to your will.

figures.description: The supreme deity of the Evenki people, the sky-world creator, whose name means both 'sky' and 'world' in the Evenki language.

figures.name: Exeri

ability.name: Helper Spirits
ability.description: Summon two helper spirits with 4/4/6/7/7 stats to assist allied cards.

figures.description: The beneficent spirits of Evenki belief who assist humans and the shaman, counterparts to the malevolent spirits.

figures.name: Hargi

ability.name: Disease Spirit
ability.description: Infect one enemy with spiritual illness; they lose 2 to all stats per turn for 3 turns.

figures.description: The evil spirits of Evenki belief who cause illness and misfortune, who must be combated by the shaman's power.

figures.name: Shaman Tengere

ability.name: Master Shaman Call
ability.description: Call the master shaman to resolve any crisis; negate one ability and cast it back doubled.

figures.description: The supreme ancestral shaman spirit of the Evenki, whose techniques and knowledge form the foundation of all Evenki shamanic practice.

figures.name: Reindeer Spirit

ability.name: Tundra Guide
ability.description: Guide all allied cards through any terrain; barriers and obstacles are ignored for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sacred reindeer spirits central to Evenki life, who serve as guides between worlds for the shaman and provide the nomadic people with everything needed.

figures.name: Three-Legged Elk

ability.name: Cosmic Elk
ability.description: Support the world tree; all allied nature cards gain +3 to all stats from cosmic connection.

figures.description: The three-legged cosmic elk of Evenki cosmology who carries the sun across the sky, associated with the world tree and cosmic order.

figures.name: Dyldal

ability.name: Lightning Gift
ability.description: Strike the earth with lightning; either destroy one enemy or create a sacred fire card.

figures.description: The lightning spirit of the Evenki, associated with the divine fire brought from the sky, connected to shamanic power and the blacksmith's art.

figures.name: Water Master (Eki)

ability.name: River Master's Gift
ability.description: Control one river; all fishing and water-gathering actions this turn yield double.

figures.description: The master spirit of rivers and bodies of water, propitiated by Evenki fishers before entering any waters.

figures.name: Forest Master

ability.name: Forest Permission
ability.description: Gain permission to hunt; all hunting actions deal double damage and yield extra resources.

figures.description: The master spirit of the taiga forest, who must grant permission for hunting to succeed; offending the forest master brings misfortune.

figures.name: Mudur

ability.name: River Dragon Rage
ability.description: The river dragon erupts; deal 7 damage to all cards in one row.

figures.description: The water dragon of Evenki belief, a great serpentine spirit of rivers and lakes whose anger brings floods and chaos.

figures.name: Enin

ability.name: Taiga Mother
ability.description: Protect all children and young cards; they gain immunity to attacks for 1 turn.

figures.description: The mother earth spirit of the Evenki taiga, who protects women in childbirth and watches over the young of both humans and animals.

figures.name: Seveki

ability.name: Game Master
ability.description: Release game animals into the field; all hunt-domain allies gain 3 resources.

figures.description: The master of animals in Evenki belief, who controls the supply of game and must be propitiated to ensure successful hunts.

figures.name: Shingken

ability.name: Ancestor's Shield
ability.description: Your lineage protects you; the ancestor spirit blocks the next attack against any allied card.

figures.description: The clan ancestor spirits of the Evenki, who protect the living descendants and are honored in clan rituals.

figures.name: Chulbegen

ability.name: Trickster Theft
ability.description: Steal one resource or card ability; the victim doesn't notice until their next turn.

figures.description: A malevolent trickster spirit of Evenki belief who steals souls and causes mischief, one of the dangerous beings that shamans must combat.

figures.name: Iron Antler Deer

ability.name: Star Deer Sprint
ability.description: Sprint across the cosmic field; move any allied card to any position instantly.

figures.description: The cosmic sky deer with iron antlers, a stellar being in Evenki mythology associated with the great hunt across the heavens.

figures.name: Shamanic Drum

ability.name: Drum Journey
ability.description: Beat the cosmic drum; send one allied card on a spirit journey gaining +4 to magic and wisdom.

figures.description: The sacred drum of the Evenki shaman, whose beating opens the path to spirit worlds and calls helping spirits to aid the shaman.

figures.name: Clan Fireplace Spirit

ability.name: Clan Fire
ability.description: Sustain all clan-allied cards; they gain 2 HP at the start of each turn while the fire burns.

figures.description: The protective spirit of the clan's sacred fireplace, whose warmth sustains the family through the brutal Siberian winters.

figures.name: Ancestral Bear

ability.name: Bear Ancestor
ability.description: Invoke the bear ancestor; all allied cards gain +2 power and become bear-totem protected.

figures.description: The bear as a clan totem animal of many Evenki groups, treated with great respect as an ancestor figure and addressed as 'grandfather.'

figures.name: Erge

ability.name: Epidemic Spread
ability.description: Spread disease across the entire enemy field; all enemies are weakened for 2 turns.

figures.description: The great disease spirit who sends epidemics and mass illness, most feared of the dark spirits among the Evenki.

figures.name: Agdy

ability.name: Thunder Purification
ability.description: Strike with purifying thunder; remove all dark spirits from the field.

figures.description: The thunder spirit of the Evenki, whose storms purify the air and drive away malevolent spirits, a powerful force of the natural world.
